description: Test suite for retention policy store functions in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, association management, and orphaned row cleanup.

methods.name: TestRetentionPolicyStore
methods.description: Main test function executing various sub-tests for retention policy store operations.

methods.name: getRetentionPolicyWithTeamAndChannelIds
methods.description: Retrieves a retention policy with associated team and channel IDs by policy ID.

methods.name: CheckRetentionPolicyWithTeamAndChannelIdsAreEqual
methods.description: Asserts equality of two retention policies with team and channel IDs.

methods.name: CheckRetentionPolicyWithTeamAndChannelCountsAreEqual
methods.description: Asserts equality of two retention policies with counts of associated teams and channels.

methods.name: checkRetentionPolicyLikeThisExists
methods.description: Verifies that a retention policy with specific IDs exists in the store.

methods.name: copyRetentionPolicyWithTeamAndChannelIds
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a retention policy with team and channel IDs.

methods.name: createChannelsForRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Creates specified number of channels for a team within a retention policy context.

methods.name: createTeamsForRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Creates specified number of teams for retention policy testing.

methods.name: createTeamsAndChannelsForRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Creates multiple teams and associated channels for testing.

methods.name: cleanupRetentionPolicyTest
methods.description: Clears retention policy related tables in the database.

methods.name: deleteTeamsAndChannels
methods.description: Deletes specified teams and channels from the store.

methods.name: createRetentionPolicyWithTeamAndChannelIds
methods.description: Constructs a retention policy object with specified team and channel IDs.

methods.name: saveRetentionPolicyWithTeamAndChannelIds
methods.description: Saves a retention policy with specified team and channel IDs, returning the saved object.

methods.name: restoreRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Reapplies a retention policy patch and verifies its existence.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreSave
methods.description: Tests saving retention policies with various configurations.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStorePatch
methods.description: Tests updating retention policies, including modifications and error cases.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreGet
methods.description: Tests retrieving retention policies, including empty and populated cases.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreGetCount
methods.description: Tests counting retention policies in the store.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of retention policies.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreGetChannels
methods.description: Tests retrieving channels associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreAddChannels
methods.description: Tests adding channels to a retention policy.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreRemoveChannels
methods.description: Tests removing channels from a retention policy.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreGetTeams
methods.description: Tests retrieving teams associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreAddTeams
methods.description: Tests adding teams to a retention policy.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreRemoveTeams
methods.description: Tests removing teams from a retention policy.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreGetPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Tests retrieving retention policies relevant to a user based on team and channel memberships.

methods.name: testRetentionPolicyStoreRemoveOrphanedRows
methods.description: Tests cleanup of orphaned retention policy rows after deletions.
